execution.timeout_enforcement: POSIX whole-cell timer at or below the preregistered maximum plus a repetition-boundary monotonic check; the actual deadline is recorded in every cell, TimeoutError bypasses per-policy recovery, and no claim is made that Python signal delivery can preempt an uninterruptible native CUDA call
execution.warmup_accounting: record attempted repetitions, paired-complete repetitions, per-policy completed runs, and every terminal warmup failure separately
execution.policy_failure_isolated: if either resident or tiered fails, continue all 30 measured repetitions for the surviving policy and report the cell as partial
